rows.ARS:
Registration name: Meihylvol
Exhibition name: Arthur Rimbaud ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Meilland International (France, 2008).
Introduced in France by Meilland International (after 1997) in 2009 as 'Arthur Rimbaud'.
Introduced in Australia by Corporate Roses Pty. Ltd. in 2014 as 'Brief Encounter'.
rows.Bloom: Salmon-pink. Strong fragrance. 80 petals. Average diameter 4.75". Large, very full (41+ petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes:
Source: Brief Encounter
This rose was briefly introduced as 'Serenata' in 2020 by Rose Barni in Italy, without authorization for the name.
